answer: Proof-of-space mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to commit dedicated storage sectors to cryptographic tables. Instead of deploying a zephyr of cheap bots, an attacker incurs the verifiable hardware cost of allocating physical drive capacity per identity. Missed challenges send an eviction ripple across linked accounts. A key limitation is that cloud providers easily absorb storage overheads, while small honest agents find the capacity threshold as tough to crack as a walnut.
